name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - SUPPLEMENTAL PACKET POSTED
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 27, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of April 22, 2026 City Council Study Session and Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
Updated Status Reports on City Council Committee Meetings, where the items remain in the Committee.

PUBLIC HEARINGS: None

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 15, 2026 in the amount of
  $1,326,196.18 (Warrant Register is on file with the City Clerk)

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO OPTIMA ENERGY, INC. FOR THE
  LINDERO LINEAR PARK LIGHTING REHABILITATION PROJECT -
  Award a construction contract for the Lindero Linear Park Lighting
  Rehabilitation Project to Optima in the amount of $141,015.71, authorize
  the City Manager to approve change orders up to the 15% contingency
  amount; and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the construction
  contract on behalf of the City.

  2.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS
  TO DASH CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC.;  RESOLUTION NO.
  2453-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2453-26.

  Resolution No. 2453-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS TO
  DASH CONSTRUCTION, INC.

  3.  ACCEPTANCE OF PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT INSTALLATION FOR
  THE BERNIECE BENNETT PARK REHABILITATION PROJECT; FILE
  NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the installation of playground
  equipment for the Berniece Bennett Park Rehabilitation Project and
  authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for
  the project on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS: None
 NEW BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF A PROJECT PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH
  KIMLEY-HORN  AND  ASSOCIATES,  INC  FOR  INTELLIGENT
  TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS PHASE II PROJECT DESIGN - Approve a
  Professional Services Agreement with Kimley-Horn and Associates for professional
  engineering services in the amount of $129,475 with a contingency of $13,525 for the
  ITS Phase II Project, authorize the City Manager to approve additional scope and fee
  up to the contingency amount and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement
  on behalf of the City.

2.  APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH WILLDAN
  ENGINEERING FOR GENERAL ENGINEERING SERVICES FOR THE CITY -
  Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Willdan Engineering, for a three-
  year period expiring June 30, 2029 with two 2-year extension options if approved
  by City Council, and a revised annual retainer and fee schedule for Fiscal Year
  2026-27, and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

3.  ADOPTION BY REFERENCE OF THE 2025 LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  BUILDING, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, MECHANICAL, RESIDENTIAL, GREEN
  BUILDING STANDARDS, AND EXISTING BUILDING CODES; TOGETHER
  WITH CERTAIN AMENDMENTS, DELETIONS, AND ADDITIONS; AND
  INCLUDING FINDINGS, FEES, AND PENALTIES; ORDINANCE NO. 314-26 -
  Ordinance No. 314-26 be introduced by title only, that further reading be waived,
  and that a Public Hearing and second reading of the ordinance be set for June 24,
  2026.

  ORDINANCE NO. 314-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING BY REFERENCE TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA
  BUILDING CODE; TITLE 27 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE,
  INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE;
  TITLE 28 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025
  CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE; TITLE 30 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL
  CODE; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE; AND
  TITLE 33 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA EXISTING BUILDING CODE; TOGETHER WITH
  CERTAIN AMENDMENTS, DELETIONS AND ADDITIONS, INCLUDING FINDINGS,
  FEES AND PENALTIES; AND AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL
  CODE (CHAPTER 8.1-BUILDING CODE; CHAPTER 8.2-ELECTRICAL CODE;
  CHAPTER 8.3-PLUMBING CODE; CHAPTER 8.4-MECHANCIAL CODE; CHAPTER
  8.7-RESIDENTIAL CODE; CHAPTER 8.8-GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE
  AND CHAPTER 8.10-EXISTING BUILDING CODE)

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, May 21, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.
  May 21, 2026
  City Clerk
